newsitem.title: HUNGARY: April boosts Hungary household savings by HUF55bln.
newsitem.headline: April boosts Hungary household savings by HUF55bln.

text.p: Hungary's net household savings rose 55 billion forints in April to 2,587.6 billion forints, the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on Thursday.
NOTE - April 1997 figures are preliminary. The figures are not inflation-adjusted.
The NBH said that net household savings rose by 176.2 billion forints in the first four months, while in the same period of 1996 the increase was lower by 4.5 billion forints.
In April, household savings rose more than the monthly average of 1996, following a slow accumulation of savings in February and March, the NBH said.
Consumer price inflation was 18.6 percent year-on-year in April. Monthly average real wages rose 5.8 percent in the first quarter of the year, compared with the same period of 1996.
